description: R88: the R87 contract (the intact single-diffraction line) with the charge-conjugate baryonic towers and the vertex-slope mass exponent 1.25, the two-component fit refitted

judgment.b_sd: 6.3 GeV^-2 by judgment (the vertex-slope scan at the R87 optimum: the kappa = 1.25 minimum near B0 = 6.2-6.4 GeV^-2; R87 fitted 4.90 at kappa = 0.75)

texts.parametrization_space: epsilon, log B_SD, epsilon_nd, logit w_excited, log flavor weights, f_isovector
texts.report_title: R88: the R87 contract with the charge-conjugate baryonic towers and the vertex-slope mass exponent 1.25
texts.report_kernel_line: the density-weighted continuation step above the 2.0 GeV floor with the P-wave barrier on the isospin-complete towers (baryonic, strange baryonic, strange mesonic) with the Delta-like lines, the sibling weight at the edge mass (the committed rule, control); the exact 2 -> 2 transfer window, the per-line thresholds, the flat three-body phase space; the model bins converted to the tabulated points (the bin-center correction); the isovector exchange fraction free; diffractive shapes free. The leading-baryon split: a share 0.2 of the baryonic continuum roots decays into its established baryon and a mesonic continuum state of mass mu, flat in ln mu^2, the baryon along the incoming baryon with exp(4 cos theta). The factorized vertex slopes: each 2 -> 2 transfer follows exp(B t) at B = b_sd [(m_p/M1)^1.25 + (m_p/M2)^1.25] / 2. The vacuum lines draw their low-mass record over the I = 1/2 records with weight 2J + 1. The isoscalar S-wave dipion: the f0(500) record (pole 475 MeV, width 550 MeV, pi pi at the I = 0 shares), the six N* multiplets at the PDG 2025 hadronic decay modes (range midpoints, isospin Clebsch-Gordan charge splits, normalized), and the (N, f0(500)) class of the baryonic continuum's direct pool. The floor pools: a charged or strange mesonic continuum state with no open continuation channel also decays into the heavier pairs (rho omega, rho rho, f2 pi, a2 pi, a1 pi, b1 pi, rho(1450) pi, phi pi, K* Kbar*; K* rho, K* omega, K eta, phi K, K1(1270) pi, K2*(1430) pi, K f2) with the direct pairs' weight law; the continuation steps keep the committed classes. The single-diffraction classes carry an intact proton on the non-excited line (the nominal R50 split was intact 0.5, low-mass resonance 0.5), as the single-diffraction anchor pp -> pX counts it. The charge-conjugate baryonic towers: the conjugate of every baryonic family, every antibaryon record the conjugate of its baryon, and the two conjugate baryon-pair continuations of a mesonic vertex at half the weight each.
texts.obligation: the two-component fit with the leading-baryon split, the factorized vertex slopes at the mass exponent 1.25, the isoscalar low-mass remnant and the isoscalar S-wave dipion at the 2.0 GeV continuation floor, with the floor pools of the charged and strange mesonic continuum, the single-diffraction non-excited line intact and the charge-conjugate baryonic towers (R88)
texts.hypothesis: The R87 kernel with the charge-conjugate baryonic towers, so that a baryon-pair step of a mesonic state continues on the baryon or the antibaryon side alike, and with the vertex slopes falling as the 1.25 power of the line mass, describes the six p+p species and the neutron dN/dx_F as measured; the fit reports the parameters and the residual map against R87 (chi2 13,572).

kernel_change.diagnosis: _knowledge/evidence/fixed-kernel-residual-mechanisms-2026-10-03.md (the vertex-slope law and the light-meson origin at the R87 optimum; the charge-conjugate baryonic towers at the R87 optimum)
kernel_change.sibling_weight: the committed q* at the fixed mass max(floor, edge - nominal width) (control)
kernel_change.bin_center: each model bin average of f is multiplied by f(x0, p0) / <f>_bin of the data's own local shape: an error-weighted five-point quadratic in log f along x_F and along p_T through the tabulated neighbors, the tangent at the end of a row; the neutron dN/dx_F by the one-dimensional factor
kernel_change.sqrt_s: the observables boost, x_F and pi sqrt(s) at the exact invariant mass 17.2702 GeV; the draw domain at 17.270
kernel_change.unchanged: everything of R87 except the conjugate towers and the slope exponent: the intact single-diffraction line, the floor pools, the 2.0 GeV continuation floor, the exact transfer window, the per-line thresholds, the three-body phase-space law, the density continuation law with the P-wave barrier, the edge sibling weight, the bin-center correction, the leading-baryon split, the isoscalar low-mass remnant, the isoscalar S-wave dipion, the class fractions at the external anchors
kernel_change.leading_split: at a baryonic continuum root (depth 0) the one channel uniform picks, with probability 0.2, a split channel (an established baryon and a mesonic continuum daughter) on the split channels' weights; the remainder's mu^2 is flat in ln mu^2 on [floor^2, edge^2] at the density uniform; the baryon's direction in the root frame follows exp(4 cos theta) about the incoming baryon (the sign of the root's c.m. p_z); the later steps are the committed cascade (2026-10-08)
kernel_change.vertex_slopes: each exact-window transfer of the 2 -> 2 classes is drawn from exp(B t) at B = b_sd [(m_p/M1)^k + (m_p/M2)^k] / 2 with k = 1.25 (0.75 through R87; the topology option transfer_slope_mass_exponent, 2026-10-09), M1 and M2 the outgoing lines' masses (a line at or below m_p counts as m_p); the event records B / b_sd and the reweighting follows it; the class with the central source keeps the single slope (2026-10-08)
kernel_change.isoscalar_remnant: the vacuum lines draw the low-mass record over the I = 1/2 records below the kernel boundary (the proton, N(1440), N(1520), N(1535), N(1650), N(1680), N(1720)) with weight 2J + 1, by the same residual uniform; the Delta+ states stay on the isovector lines (2026-10-08)
kernel_change.isoscalar_dipion: KernelConfig.isoscalar_dipion (na49_mixing.isoscalar_dipion, config/v2_singlet/isoscalar_dipion_pdg2025.json): the f0(500) record (I = 0, J^P = 0+, pole 475 MeV, width 550 MeV, support from the pi0 pi0 threshold to 1.0 GeV, pi+ pi- : pi0 pi0 = 2 : 1 in an S-wave); N(1440), N(1520), N(1535), N(1650), N(1680) and N(1720) at every PDG 2025 hadronic mode whose daughters are catalog records (N pi, N eta, Delta pi, N rho, N sigma, N omega, Lambda K, N(1440) pi, N(1520) pi) at the range midpoints (half an upper limit), split by the isospin Clebsch-Gordan shares and normalized to unity; the (2212, 9000221) class in the baryonic_np direct pool, rotated to the charge partners by the isospin completion (the I = 3/2 families at Clebsch-Gordan weight 0) (2026-10-08)
kernel_change.continuation_floor: every family's continuation floor at 2.0 GeV (1.7 GeV since R74): a continuum state below it decays directly into two established hadrons; the leading-baryon split's remainder follows it (2026-10-09)
kernel_change.floor_pools: KernelConfig.floor_pools ['charged', 'strange'] (na49_mixing.floor_pools): the I = 1 partners of the neutral pool's heavier pairs in the charged and anticharged mesonic families and the heavier strange pairs in the four strange mesonic families join the direct pairs of a vertex with no open continuation channel, with the direct pairs' weight law (2026-10-09)
kernel_change.diffractive_split: the run spec's diffractive_split {intact_proton 1.0, low_mass_baryonic_resonance 0.0, high_mass_baryonic_continuum 0.0} on the single-diffraction non-excited line (the nominal R50 split 0.5/0.5/0.0 before; the anchor sigma_SD = 6.5 mb counts pp -> pX with the recoil proton) (2026-10-09)
kernel_change.conjugate_towers: KernelConfig.conjugate_towers (na49_mixing.conjugate_towers): the conjugate of every B = +1 family appended (quantum numbers, classes and floor classes conjugated), every antibaryon record rebuilt as the conjugate of its baryon, the two conjugate baryon-pair continuations of a mesonic vertex at half the weight each, the strangeness signs of an antibaryonic vertex's flavor exponents conjugated (2026-10-09)
